research_plan.layer_selection: Cross-validate layer depth on training families only; freeze before held-out evaluation.
research_plan.transcript_filter: Exclude empty, system-only, or malformed audit transcripts.
research_plan.sample_sizing: Size clean runs per family upfront for tight <=5% held-out false-positive intervals.

legacy_monitor.calibration_note: In-family operating points are selected within the displayed subset at <=5% FPR. Holdout thresholds use only clean runs from the other five families.
legacy_monitor.description: 600 Claude Haiku 4.5 monitor evaluations across 5 transcript views on 120 balanced 6-family trajectories (60 positive runs vs 60 clean runs) plus 400 reference-monitor records (1,000 monitor score records in total, alongside 69 SWE-bench Verified runs for 160 unique trajectories)
legacy_monitor.extension_question: Resident extension: test multi-agent subagent handoffs using action-time activation probes and deterministic test-diff gates.
legacy_monitor.holdout_finding: Six-family leave-one-family-out transfer breaks FPR control: pooled 6.7% for completion summaries and 8.3% for full traces and git diff logs; tool-masked and two-stage views remain at 5.0%. Completion-summary thresholds calibrated on five families range from 0.90 to 0.92. Holdout FPR reaches 41.7% (5/12) on terminal-bench-2 and 66.7% (4/6) on swe-bench-verified.
